data.headline: Asbury Park agenda includes Waterfront Redevelopment Area application

claims.text: The Asbury Park Planning Board signal recorded 2 agenda-item mentions of the Waterfront Redevelopment Area.

citation.quote: Design exceptions requested for various architectural design standards of the Waterfront Redevelopment area.

claims.text: The agenda identifies The Views at Westley Lake at 216 Cookman Avenue as a preliminary and final major site-plan application in the Waterfront Redevelopment Area and Prime Renewal Area.

citation.quote: PB-2026-01 / The Views at Westley Lake / 216 Cookman Avenue / Block 3802, Lot 1 / APW Redeveloper, LLC / Preliminary & Final Major Site Plan / Waterfront Redevelopment Area / Prime Renewal Area

claims.text: The applicant seeks a multi-family apartment building with 27 residences in a four-story building.

citation.quote: Applicant seeks to construct a multi-family apartment building containing 27 residences in a four-story building: two, one-bedroom units, 10 two-bedroom units and 15 three-bedroom units, each with a balcony.

claims.text: STHO's Asbury Park Waterfront strategy is to strategically monetize remaining development sites and operating assets through sales to third-party developers and operators while meeting redevelopment-agreement obligations.

citation.quote: Our current strategy for the Asbury Park Waterfront investment is to actively asset manage our operating assets, and strategically monetize the remaining development sites and our operating assets through sales to third party developers and operators while meeting our obligations under the redevelopment agreement with the city of Asbury Park.
